title: Please Handle
alt: Four panels. 1: A note pokes out of the brass pneumatic tube on the wall with a FWUMP; Margo throws her arms up at her desk while Pip stands nervously nearby. 2: Close-up of the note: 'Please handle. -H.' 3: Pip asks 'Handle what?' and Margo, deadpan behind her desk, answers 'He doesn't say.' 4: Margo says 'It's handled.' A stamp sits on her desk and her open drawer holds a tall stack of identical notes; Pip looks on, puzzled.
hover: The drawer is full. Nobody has ever written back.
note: Forty years of notes, one method.
